objective: Revise the natural-language conditioned scenario-generator manuscript into a concise public technical paper. Keep the current nearest-similar top3/90 support-posterior workflow and evidence, but rewrite the abstract, introduction, related work, method/results framing, and appendix/provider language so the paper no longer reads like an internal autoresearch report.

current_production_candidate.name: Nearest similar regimes / Main-regime view
current_production_candidate.tradeoff: Main-regime views strengthen fixed-start narrative and portfolio conditionality relative to all-regime pooling. The three-start high-sample confirmation ranks top3_90 first on the current weighted tradeoff because it has stronger calibration and larger portfolio-tail spread; top2_80 remains the sharper KS-oriented variant; all-regime pooling remains the calibration diagnostic. The 963c verifier agrees with promoting top3_90 as the current paper/demo candidate under this tradeoff framing.

product_conditionality_definition.summary: A risk-manager narrative is conditionally useful only if, for the same approved starting market level, a materially different professional narrative changes the auditable support mixture and produces a distinguishable future risk distribution in the risk channels implied by that narrative, above repeat, bootstrap, and start-only controls.
gates: semantic_gate: professional narrative text and sidecar preserve the scenario spine, trigger, mechanism, transmission channel, cross-asset reaction, sequencing, portfolio implication, ambiguity, and no-forecast caveat
support_gate: different narratives select different diverse non-overlapping support mixtures while same-narrative repeats and start-only controls do not
prefix_gate: selected supports decode into materially different recent-prefix objects under the same fixed start
factor_distribution_gate: generated factor path distributions separate beyond same-narrative repeat and within-run bootstrap noise
portfolio_tail_gate: portfolio PnL, VaR/ES-style tail metrics, and contribution views move in the risk channels implied by the narrative
audit_gate: the app/report exposes narrative, sidecar, fixed start, support windows, support weights, diagnostics, warnings, and artifacts

incumbent_benchmark.name: soft_topk_narrative_start_checked / narrative_generator_topk
incumbent_benchmark.distributional_floor: New methods must be at least competitive with the simple mixture on ensemble CRPS, energy score, and 80% coverage before promotion. A small regression is acceptable only if it buys clear trust, stability, or conditionality gains and is documented as a trade-off.
incumbent_benchmark.non_promotion_rule: Do not promote methods that materially regress below the simple mixture while only improving retrieval rank, target cosine, or an isolated diagnostic.

research_lanes.exploration: Cheap mechanism-seeking tests may regress, including severe regression, if the result is low cost and explains whether to continue, change, or kill the branch.
research_lanes.candidate: A plausible method may tolerate moderate regression only when the trade-off and falsifier were stated before the run.
research_lanes.promotion: A candidate must be competitive with the simple mixture on held-out scenario metrics, support audits, fixed-start controls, and null or repeat checks before it changes defaults or paper claims.
research_lanes.production_demo: User-facing defaults may not drastically regress; small regressions require a visible trust, warning, OOD, provenance, or fixed-start stability benefit.

deprioritized_candidate_notes: Multiple response-aware support-weighting probes improved selected fixed-start conditionality diagnostics but did not produce a promoted default across held-out quality and stress gates; the next objective should avoid another ranker-only variant unless it directly tests support coherence and component-posterior formation.

Prompt-only or generic embedding-only work is deprioritized because semantic, support, decoded-prefix, and fixed-start component-preserving conditionality gates are supported; the active bottleneck is stronger product-useful response in the narrative's risk channels after start normalization.

research_log_failure_recap.summary: Offline response-aware weighting and preview methods repeatedly looked promising at small or cached gates, but several live, scaled, or default gates either smoothed away response, failed direction contracts, or underperformed the incumbent on scenario-quality metrics. The 944a attribution audit then showed that start dominates raw-level geometry while narrative is more visible after start normalization.

sophisticated_method_gate.method_story: Explain how the method turns a risk-manager narrative plus fixed start into an auditable support-grounded ensemble and then calibrates that ensemble.
sophisticated_method_gate.related_work_basis: Cite primary related work or first-principles local evidence supporting the design family.
sophisticated_method_gate.novelty_claim: State what is new relative to CLIP-style alignment, retrieval/RAG, text-to-time-series generation, and financial scenario generation.
sophisticated_method_gate.elegance_check: Explain why the added component is necessary and not just another knob.
sophisticated_method_gate.backtest_gate: Compare same-seed held-out historical backtests against the simple mixture floor using CRPS, energy, coverage, fixed-start controls, null/repeat checks, and support audits.
sophisticated_method_gate.kill_condition: State the result that stops the branch before launching the run.

first_gate: Promoted fixed-start narrative conditioning claims must include tracked case specs, artifact paths, verifier report, fixed-start equality, support-direction checks, per-start quality, null or repeat baselines, and start-damping diagnostics before production promotion.

latest_safe_haven_gold_channel_audit.interpretation: No evidence of a table, factor-index, or top3/90 selection bug. The Safe-haven narrative selects Gold-up support prefixes, but the frozen SNI rollout from the same start gives a baseline-neutral day-30 Gold terminal distribution.

latest_safe_haven_gold_start_sensitivity.interpretation: Changing the accepted starting level within the current professional top3/90 artifact set does not produce a material Gold terminal response versus the start-only baseline. The weak Gold response is not unique to start 22; it reflects the current frozen-generator/support response for this narrative.

latest_safe_haven_gold_mechanism_audit.interpretation: Grounding/support checks validate the current/recent prefix, not a day-30 Gold target. Historical Safe-haven Gold prefixes are not strongly predictive of further Gold upside, the start-only baseline often selects similar Gold-up supports, and the frozen SNI rollout shrinks support-specific Gold outcomes toward a calibrated terminal distribution.
